create_logical_factor_group: create a LogicalFactorGroup to represent a group of ORFactors or ANDFactors with a shared edge_states_offset
create_or_factor_group: create an ORFactorGroup with edge_states_offset=1 for grouping OR logical factors
create_and_factor_group: create an ANDFactorGroup with edge_states_offset=-1 for grouping AND logical factors
build_variables_to_factors: build a mapping from variable sets to LogicalFactor instances via _get_variables_to_factors
review_logical_factor_group: review the LogicalFactorGroup class and its inheritance hierarchy for ORFactorGroup and ANDFactorGroup
